editorial:
Imagine being hired for a boring job cleaning out an old prison, only to have your day ruined by a squad of high-tech mercenaries. That is exactly what happens to Cross and his partner Manning. You get to follow these two as they try to protect two mysterious women who were just locked up. The vibe is very much like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where the walls are closing in. It starts off slow, but once the shooting starts, it feels like a nonstop fight for survival in a creepy, empty building.

What really works here are the fight scenes and the surprise twists about who the female prisoners actually are. While some of the dialogue feels a bit cheesy, the action keeps you glued to your seat. If you love movies where one guy takes on an entire army, you will have a blast.
endingExplained: You find out the two women are actually high-level agents with secrets that the mercenaries want at any cost. In the final showdown, Cross uses his black ops skills to outsmart the attackers. He manages to take down the lead mercenary in a brutal fight, ensuring the women get to safety. Everything wraps up with the bad guys defeated and the mystery solved, leaving Cross to walk away from the ruins of the prison.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves one-man-army action movies and prison breakouts.
